address: piazza della Chiesa 14, loc. San Pietro all'Olmo, Cornaredo, 20007, Italy
bio: In a charming square showcasing an elm and a 17th-century church overlooking table seating in two of three dining rooms, Chef Davide Oldani is a mature figure in Italian cuisine. His precise and recognisable style encapsulates his two decades of rigorous independent work, incorporating all past celebrated experiences—from the unforgettable beginnings under the greats Marchesi and Ducasse, to name but a few—combining creative ideas rooted in Italian tastes, superior technique, precise and artful presentations, offering convincingly delightful flavours. Year on year, the elements are so finely polished, as seen in the farinaceous and leavened selections, for instance, assigned to a dedicated laboratory.
